summary: A child is told about the parents' divorce years after it happened.
realLife: A woman born about 1924 said her parents divorced in 1932, when she was about eight, and her mother did not tell her until she was thirteen.
sources: Kennesaw State University, Georgia Journeys, Detroit Childhood oral history: https://georgiajourneys.kennesaw.edu/items/show/157
inGame: `household:parent-apart` with `named`. `needs:` when and by whom the child was told.

turns.turn: The child is told at once.
turns.writesBack: the line says who told them and what was said
